Statement 'documented-example-literal' is recorded as unresolved: Whether a protocol's published example literal is expected silent is a maintainer decision.

Decided 2026-10-04 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner), ADR 0019 item 7 (#114), RFC 7617 example. This case decides its fixture. Question: Is the RFC 7617 published Basic example (Aladdin:open sesame) expected unflagged? Options: must-not-flag only for the exact published literal, must-flag, or keep unresolved. Decision: must-not-flag for the exact published literal only; any other value is flagged. The same rule as for provider example keys (aws-example-keys-one-character-off). Reason: The standard publishes the value as an example, and the project treats a documented example literal as a placeholder, never a one-character variant of it. Project policy, not a provider rule or a fact. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
